name: ANY in sequence and regex context
desc: Successor union across empty, fixed, and variable widths; continuation and exactness across every endpoint; arrays and virtual Unicode character arrays; context boundaries, EXPR, zero-width alternate-target assertions, and capture suppression including fresh function match states.
